items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Brand identities run 4–6 weeks. A brand plus website is usually 8–12 weeks, depending on scope and content.
Projects typically start at $15k. After a short intro call we send a fixed quote, so there are no surprises.

items.q: Do you work with early-stage startups?
items.a: Yes. We have packages for pre-seed and seed teams that need to look credible fast without overbuilding.

items.q: Can we update the website ourselves?
items.a: Always. Every site ships with an easy editor and a recorded walkthrough for your team.
Our studio is in New York, and we work with clients across North America and Europe.
